thread:
tom-ellis: Quick update: Private Console Consent + Audit Flow is moving from pilot to opt-in GA next week. This formalizes admin consent and retention controls for private/VPC/on-prem installs.

sarah-lee: Nice. Does GA include the new retention policy toggle for audit bundles?

tom-ellis: Yes 12. Admins can now choose retention windows (30/90/365 days) for exported bundles and logs. Default is 90 days for pilot customers, GA will default to 365 for enterprise tenants unless they opt for shorter retention.

infra-bot: Rollout schedule: pilot -> 1801203456 (now), opt-in GA -> 1801808256 (7 days). Initial regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Feature flag: private.console.auditflow set to true for pilot accounts.

legal-ops: Reminder: attestation template updated yesterday. Legal sign-off required before any customer can enable automated exports for regulated workloads.

se-team: Any CLI changes for air-gapped customers? We need to update our runbooks.

tom-ellis: CLI additions: a consent token flow and a single-step export command. Examples:

```
rwctl consent create --admin-email admin@acme.com --cidrs 10.0.0.0/16,192.168.1.0/24 --out consent.pdf
rwctl audit export --consent /tmp/consent.pdf --mode offline --out /tmp/audit-1801203456.zip
```

ops-bot: Note: consent PDFs are signed with a timestamp and stored in the tenant metadata. Deleting a consent record will not retroactively delete previously exported bundles (audit trail preserved).

customer-success: We'll need a short FAQ for compliance teams about retention and redaction options. Also prepare a template email for customers when SEs request admin consent.

legal-ops: Also flag: export redaction is available (hosts/IPs). Redaction must be explicitly approved by Admin and is logged with operator signature. That change was requested by privacy earlier.

infra-bot: Security note: export bundles include KMS/HSM usage metadata only; no private keys are ever included. If customers want stronger HSM proof, they must enable HSM audit logging and provide the logs for inclusion.

sarah-lee: Exec asks: does this change our compliance posture for Private customers? Short answer for EVP comms?

tom-ellis: Short answer: this improves evidence packaging and admin control; it does not change our shared-responsibility model. For EVP note: "New Console Consent + Audit Flow streamlines evidence export for regulated customers while preserving tenant key secrecy and admin control." Keep it concise.

se-team: Action: SEs add pilot accounts to tracker by 1801220000 and schedule 30-min walkthroughs.

customer-success: Will prepare the FAQ and email templates, and coordinate with marketing for a one-page summary for compliance officers.

legal-ops: Action: Legal to confirm attestation language by 1801260000.

ops-bot: Deploy note: backend change rolled at 1801203500; UI toggle for admin consent available in staging. Monitor errors in the first 24h.

tom-ellis: Thanks all. If you see any missing edge cases in the runbook, ping me directly or drop notes in the pilot channel. :thumbsup:
